note: Derived from committed evaluation receipts. Every state here is evidence-backed; a layer with no receipt reads UNKNOWN rather than green.

teamSimulation.headline: We do not publish a prediction for preseason games
teamSimulation.detail: A preseason-specific model was built and tested on a held-out season. It picked winners no better than a coin flip (0.6933 against a coin's 0.6931), and its score ranges missed the accuracy and calibration bars that were set before the test. The bars were not lowered afterwards, so the model holds.
teamSimulation.nextGate: Regular season kickoff in September, where the evaluated model already clears its bar on a held-out 2025 season.

market.headline: Sportsbook prices are published for this slate
market.detail: Captured before every kickoff shown, across up to 11 sportsbooks. These are the books' own numbers with attribution — not GameTimePicks predictions.

playerFamilies.label: Passing yards
playerFamilies.headline: Passing yards: held for preseason
playerFamilies.detail: Two things are missing, and either alone is enough to hold: nobody can say which players will take the field in a preseason game, and the sportsbooks are not offering this market for these games.
playerFamilies.nextGate: Regular-season participation evidence and an offered market.
playerFamilies.modelStanding: The projection model is still research — its ranges are not yet reliable enough to publish.

anytimeTd.headline: Anytime touchdown: held
anytimeTd.detail: The scoring model is calibrated, but the sportsbooks are not offering touchdown markets for these preseason games, and preseason playing time is unknown. Both must change before anything publishes.
